stock.description: Golden Power Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, with its primary focus being the global production and sale of diverse battery solutions for a wide array of electronic devices. Its commercial reach extends across the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and various international markets. The company's business is organized into two distinct divisions: single-use batteries, and rechargeable power sources alongside other related accessories. The disposable segment supplies conventional cylindrical batteries and miniature button cells, while the rechargeable division provides items such as battery chargers, portable power banks, and even electric fans. Golden Power markets its products under its proprietary brand, as well as through private labeling and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) agreements. Beyond its core battery operations, the company also engages in real estate investment and management, general commercial trading, and the wholesale distribution of batteries and complementary products. Established in 1972, Golden Power Group Holdings Limited is headquartered in Tai Po, Hong Kong, and functions as a subsidiary of Golden Villa Ltd.
